methods.what: Mean of solar diameter observations from cumulative weighted sums (weights times values), converted to arcseconds
Thread interval from differences of successive circle readings (alternate settings), taking the mean of the threefold differences, with and without level correction
Clear interval between threads = thread spacing minus estimated thread thickness
